patterns.message: The web app must never import gateway code: it contains the pool-key decrypt path (docs/plan/04 §3.1).

Import only the narrow subpaths the web app is allowed to use (@deepcode/shared/node/keys, @deepcode/shared/node/pool-crypto). The aggregate entry may gain decrypt-capable helpers later; the ban keeps apps/web free of them (docs/plan/04 §3.1).
